key.name: show-vinyl
key.description: Whether to show the spinning vinyl record.

key.name: vinyl-size
key.description: Diameter of the vinyl record in pixels.

key.name: vinyl-speed
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for one 360-degree rotation.

key.name: margin-x
key.description: Horizontal distance from screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-y
key.description: Vertical distance from panel/screen top in pixels.

key.name: always-on-top
key.description: Keep vinyl record visible above application windows.

key.name: inner-size
key.description: Percentage of vinyl radius for the album cover label (20 to 75).

key.name: cache-max-artists
key.description: Maximum number of most frequent artists to preserve in local database.

key.name: cache-max-size-mb
key.description: Maximum disk size for cached artist wallpapers in megabytes.

key.name: cover-scale
key.description: Scale percentage of album cover inside circular label (5 to 300).

key.name: prefer-logo
key.description: Prefer band or artist logo wallpaper over photo when available in TheAudioDB.
